paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapate leh na inkuan un mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna na la ding uh ahi. Nang leh na tapate kia in siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte a mohpuakna na puak ding uh ahi.
heading: Levite Leh Siampute Sep Dingte
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

paite: Na unaute, Levi suante leh na pa inkote hon tawnpih in, huchi a amau mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai a mohpuakna alaktheihna ding un. Nang leh na tapate'n bel siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte ah mohpuakna na lak ding uh ahi.
english: Your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you: but you and your sons with you shall be before the tent of the testimony.

paite: Nna nasep ahon huh ding ua, puanin nasep tengteng atang ding ua, himahleh mun siangthou tui-um belsuan leh maitam pen hon naih kei uhen, asihlouhna ding un, amau hiam, nang hiam in leng.
english: They shall keep your commands, and the duty of all the Tent: only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they, nor you.

paite: Puanin nasepna tengteng ah kihoupihna biakbuk nna pen atang ding uh. Namdangte'n nou ahon naih ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: They shall be joined to you, and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come near to you.

paite: Nang mun siangthou nasep leh maitam nasep pen na tang ding, Israel suante tung a hehna a-om nawnlouhna ding in.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary, and the duty of the altar; that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, ke'n na unau Levite, Israel suante lak a pan ka telkhia a, kihoupihna biakbuk ah asem ding uh. TOUPA'N nang a hon thilthawnpiak ahi uh.
english: I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Nang leh na tapate'n maitam leh puanzak sunglam thu ah na siampu nasep uh na sem ding uh. Nang na sem dia; siampu nasep na sep ding in ka hon pia hi. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and you shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a, "Ngai in, Israelte thil siangthou teng lak a kei a dia vei thillat teng leng ka hon pia hi. Thaunilh na hih ziak leh na tapate tangtawn dan ding ahih ziak in huaite ka hon pia hi.
heading: Siampute Tanvou
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “I, behold, I have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel; to you have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

paite: Mei a dia keptuam, thillat siangthoupente nang a ahi ding uh. Athillat teng uh, tangbuang thillat hiam khelhna thillat hiam mohna thillat hiam tantuan thillat tengteng nang leh na tapate tantuan ahi uh.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

paite: Mun siangthoupen ah na ne ding ua; pasal teng in ane ding ua, nou a ding in hiai thil siangthou ahi.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

paite: "Hiaite kei a tuam ahi; athilpiak uh tangbuang thillat, Israel suante vei thillat tengteng tan in. Nang, na tapate leh tanute a dia tangtawn a na tantuam ding ua ka hon piak ahi. Na inn a misiang tengteng in ane thei ding uh.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Sathau hoihpen, grep hoihpen, buh hoihpen leh gah masapen TOUPA a dia apiak teng uh ka hon pia hi.
english: “All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh, to you have I given them.

paite: Alou ua gah min masapen TOUPA a dia ahon tawi uh nang a ahi dia; na inn a misiang teng in ane thei ding uh.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Israelte thillat tengteng nang a ahi ding.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

paite: "TOUPA a dia apiak uh sul hong masapen peuhmah mihing leng gan leng nang a ahi ding. Himahleh tapa masapen zaw na tan ngeingei dia, gan siang lou nou suakkhe masapen leng na tat ding ahi.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal shall be yours: nevertheless you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

paite: "Kha khat ahih in tat dingte tatna man na sehdan bang in, mun siangthou a shekel hihdan bang a shekel nga a na tat ding ahi, shekel tuh gerah sawmnih ahi.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).

paite: Himahleh bawng suakkhe masapen hiam, belam suakkhe masapen hiam, kel suakkhe masapen hiam, na tat ding ahi kei; asiangthou uhi. Asisan uh maitam ah na theh dia, TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in athaute mei a thillat in na hal ding ahi.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Asa uh nang a ahi dia, vei thillat leh aliang taklam pang nang a ahih bang in.
english: Their flesh shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

paite: "Thil siangthou vei thillat, Israel suante'n TOUPA a dia alatte uh tangtawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi. TOUPA ma a nang, na tapate leh na tanute a dia tangtawn thukhun ahi," achi hi.
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever: it is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your seed with you.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Agam uah goutan na nei kei dia, alak uah leng tantuan na nei sam kei ding. Israel suante lak a na tantuan leh na goutan, Keimah ka hi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

paite: "Ngai in, anasep, puanin a asep man ding un, Israel gam a sawm-a-khat tengteng Levi suante kiang ah ka pia ahi.
heading: Levite Tanvou
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Tu a pan Israel suante'n kihoupihna biakbuk ahon naih het louh ding uh ahi; khelhna pua in asi kha ding uh.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

paite: Himahleh Levite'n bel kihoupihna biakbuk nasep asem ding ua; Israelte khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna ala ding uh. Hiai asuante tan a ding in dan thusehsa hi dia; Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

paite: Israel suante'n sawm-a-khat TOUPA a dia vei thillat alat uh Levite goutan ding in ka pia hi. Huaiziak in akiang uah, Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh, ka na chita him ahi," achi hi.
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Levite Sawm-a-khat
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite houpih inla, akiang uah, na goutan ding ua Israel suante sawm- a-khat ka hon piak na lak chiang un, huai sawm-a-khat a pan sawm-a-khat TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat ding in na lan ding uh ahi.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

paite: Na vei thillat uh buhphual a buh leh uain tung masapen dia sim ahi ding.
english: Your wave offering shall be reckoned to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the winepress.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a sawm-a-khat na lak tengteng uah leng TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan zui zel ding uhi; huai TOUPA vei thillat pen siampu Aaron na piak ding uh ahi.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

paite: Na thillat tengteng lak ua ahoihpen, asiangthoupen TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
english: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every wave offering of Yahweh, of all its best, even the holy part of it out of it.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah, ahoihpen na vei chiang un Levite buhphual a tung leh grep sukna a pan tung bang a sim ahi ding.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the winepress.

paite: Koi lai peuh ah leng na ne thei ding uh, nou leh na inkuanpihte un leng; kihoupihna biakbuk a na sep man uh ahi ngal a.
english: You shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Ahoihpen na vei uleh akhelh moh na po kei ding uh. Israel suante thil siangthou na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best: and you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
